highlights.title: Location-specific Club plans
highlights.description: Location-specific onboarding, versioned plans, dated enrollments, pods, quarter scheduling and prepaid reservations.

highlights.title: Guest and group booking
highlights.description: Standalone guest passes, invitation links, named booking guests, walk-in participants and member conversion.

highlights.title: Private Media Vaults
highlights.description: Private uploads, volunteer access, previews, exports and review workflows for session media.

highlights.title: Expanded Bubbles checkout
highlights.description: Broader Bubbles and discount checkout, bank transfers and verified offline payment recording. Rewards existed before Q3.

highlights.title: Community Experience ticketing
highlights.description: Optional packages, named participant checkout and calendar planning. Capability does not establish ticket sales or attendance.

highlights.title: Volunteer recognition and automation
highlights.description: Template-generated opportunities, shift overrides and volunteer-of-the-month recognition.

highlights.title: Stroke Lab improvements
highlights.description: Coaching selection/retry refinements and a larger public upload limit. The public analyzer existed before Q3.

highlights.title: Modular Academy curriculum
highlights.description: Curriculum pathway documentation; delivery of new modules in Q3 is not established.
